questions.text: When the web server receives an HTTP request for a PHP page, the web server calls the _____________.
questions.explanation:
The web server passes PHP code to the PHP interpreter to execute before sending the result back to the browser.

Student note: The browser receives the generated HTML. It does not normally execute server-side PHP.

questions.text: Which of the following software is a web browser?
questions.explanation:
Google Chrome is a web browser. phpMyAdmin manages databases, Microsoft Outlook is an email application, and Apache is a web server.

Student note: Know the job of each tool in a PHP development setup: browser, web server, PHP interpreter and database server.

questions.text: The first part of a URL is called the ___________.
questions.explanation:
The URL begins with its protocol or scheme, for example https://.

Student note: In https://example.com/page, https is the scheme and example.com is the domain.

questions.text: Which of the following is not a database server that can be used for dynamic web pages?
questions.explanation:
MySQL, SQL Server and Oracle are database systems. Python is a programming language.

Student note: A language can query a database without being a database server.

questions.text: What type of request does a Web browser typically send to a server?
questions.explanation:
Browsers request webpages through HTTP or its encrypted form HTTPS.

Student note: FTP handles file transfers. HTTP is the application protocol of the web.

intval(15 / 12) is 1 and 15 % 12 is 3, so the else branch creates '1 years and 3 months'.

Student note: Follow what the code actually prints, even if the grammar is imperfect. The program uses 'years' for both one and many.

The for loop runs at i = 1 through i = 9 because its condition is i < 10.

Student note: Count the values included by the condition; starting at 1 with < 10 means nine passes.

questions.text:
Assume that today is 24th of February 2026. What will be displayed when $date is echoed out? 

$date = date('d/m/y');
questions.explanation:
In PHP's date() pattern, d means two-digit day, m means two-digit month and y means two-digit year.

Student note: Lowercase y gives 26; uppercase Y would give 2026. This question tells you to assume 24 February 2026.

== checks equality after type conversion, whereas === checks both type and value. var_export(..., true) turns booleans into the strings 'true' and 'false'.

Student note: An integer 10 and string '10' may compare equal with == but not with ===.

questions.text: Which one of the following statements store 0 in $result after execution?
questions.explanation:
The modulus operator % returns the remainder. 10 % 2 is 0; multiplying by 2 still gives 0.

Student note: Arithmetic order matters. Use % for the remainder, not for a percentage.

questions.text:
Study the SQL query below: 

SELECT vendorName, invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, invoiceTotal

FROM vendors INNER JOIN invoices

ON vendors.vendorID = invoices.vendorID

WHERE invoiceTotal >= 500

ORDER BY vendorName

 If vendorName contains string data and invoiceTotal contains decimal values, how will the result set be ordered?
questions.explanation:
The query filters invoices using invoiceTotal >= 500 but sorts by vendorName. Without DESC, ORDER BY normally sorts ascending, beginning with A.

Student note: WHERE decides which rows appear; ORDER BY decides their sequence. Do not confuse invoiceTotal filtering with sorting.

questions.text: When you code a DELETE statement, you usually need to include ___________.
questions.explanation:
A WHERE clause limits which rows a DELETE statement removes. Without it, DELETE may remove every row in the table.

Student note: For deletion tasks, always check the WHERE condition before running the query.

questions.text: Which of the following is incorrect regarding relational databases?
options: A database can have multiple tables
A database table can have many primary keys
A database table can have many foreign keys
A database table can have many rows and columns
questions.correctAnswer: A database table can have many primary keys
questions.explanation:
A relational table has one primary-key definition, although it can contain more than one column (a composite primary key).

Student note: A table may have many foreign keys but only one declared primary key constraint.

questions.text: Which is a data type used for a column in a database table?
questions.explanation:
INT is a SQL data type for whole numbers. PRIMARY, FOREIGN and INDEX describe database constraints or structures, not column data types.

Student note: Other common data types include VARCHAR, DATE and DECIMAL.

questions.text: Which type of SQL statement returns a result set?
questions.explanation:
SELECT asks the database for matching records and returns a result set.

Student note: INSERT adds rows, UPDATE changes data, CREATE defines objects, and SELECT reads data.

questions.text:
Study the database table named weather given below, where record_number is the primary key: 



 Which one of the following SQL queries will retrieve the following data set?
options: SELECT place FROM weather WHERE rainfall > 10
SELECT place FROM weather WHERE rainfall > 10 ORDER BY place ASC
SELECT place FROM weather WHERE rainfall > 10 ORDER BY place DESC
questions.correctAnswer: SELECT place FROM weather WHERE rainfall > 10 ORDER BY place DESC
questions.explanation:
SELECT place returns only the place column; WHERE rainfall > 10 selects Gordons Bay (12), Johannesburg (25) and Roodepoort (25). DESC sorts their names from Z to A.

Student note: Do the query in three steps: SELECT the columns, apply WHERE to rows, then ORDER BY. The image for Q16 has six records, including Roodepoort.

questions.text:
Study the database table named weather given below, where record_number is the primary key: 

 

Which one of the following options will result in $result storing the following result?

Gordons Bay,12

Johannesburg,25

Hammanskral,7

Mamelodi,1

Port Elizabeth,3 

Assume that a PDO object named $db is correctly connected to the relevant database.
questions.explanation:
SELECT * fetches every column in table order. With default PDO::FETCH_BOTH, $record[1] is place and $record[3] is rainfall. prepare(), execute() and fetchAll() must run before the foreach loop.

Student note: Index 0 is record_number, 1 is place, 2 is date and 3 is rainfall. The Q17 image has five rows and Mamelodi rainfall is 1, not 10.

questions.text: Which one of the following is incorrect about PDO?
options: PDO facilitates database access in PHP
Creation of PDO object can result in errors that can be handled using try catch statement
One can specify the name of the database table when creating a PDO object
A PDO object can be created using three arguments
questions.correctAnswer: One can specify the name of the database table when creating a PDO object
questions.explanation:
PDO creates a connection to a database server/database, not directly to a particular table.

Student note: A table name belongs inside an SQL statement, such as SELECT ... FROM weather, not the PDO connection string.

options: $a, $b and $c contains the exception handling code
questions.explanation:
In new PDO($a, $b, $c), $a is the DSN containing connection details including the database name, $b is the username and $c is the password.

Student note: The assessment calls $a the database name, but technically it is a DSN such as mysql:host=localhost;dbname=testdb.

questions.text: In the catch block of a try/catch statement for handling PDO exceptions, you can get a message that describes the exception by using the getMessage() method of the _____.
questions.explanation:
PDO database errors can be caught as PDOException objects. getMessage() supplies the error explanation.

Student note: Inside catch (PDOException $e), use $e->getMessage() when handling errors.

questions.text: What does the acronym MVC stand for?
questions.explanation:
MVC means Model–View–Controller, a design pattern for separating data, presentation and application control.

Student note: Model = data and business rules; View = presentation; Controller = request handling.

questions.text: Which component of MVC contains code to access database in a web application?
questions.explanation:
The Model is the MVC layer that handles application data and commonly works with the database.

Student note: A model may use a separate repository/service for database calls in larger applications; the key exam distinction is Model versus View.

questions.text: When you use the MVC pattern, the ________________ consists of the HTML and PHP files that make up the user interface of the application.
questions.explanation:
The View produces the user-facing interface, typically through HTML and template/PHP files.

Student note: A View displays information. It should not become the main place for database logic.

questions.text: When you use the MVC pattern, the controller gets the HTTP requests and then directs the use of the files that represent ____________.
options: the model, the view and the database
the model, the view and the user interface
questions.explanation:
The Controller receives HTTP requests and decides how to use the Model and View to respond.

Student note: Controller receives a request, asks the Model for data, and chooses the View.

questions.text: When you use the MVC pattern, _________________.
options: all the PHP code is in the controller
the pattern is used in every PHP file of the application
it is easier to test and debug the application
questions.correctAnswer: it is easier to test and debug the application
questions.explanation:
Keeping concerns separate makes MVC applications easier to test, debug and maintain.

Student note: MVC is an organisation pattern; it does not automatically make software faster.

questions.text: Which type of error is considered the easiest to find?
questions.explanation:
Syntax errors break the grammar rules of PHP, so the interpreter usually reports them clearly.

Student note: Examples include missing quotation marks and badly formed PHP expressions.

questions.text: Which type of error does not violate the rules for how PHP statements must be written but will cause the PHP interpreter to display errors?
questions.explanation:
Runtime errors happen while valid PHP code is running, such as a failed connection or unavailable resource.

Student note: A syntax error stops the code being parsed; a runtime failure occurs during execution.

questions.text: An error that lets the application run but produces the wrong results is known as a _________.
questions.explanation:
A logic error means the program executes but computes an incorrect result.

Student note: Check the conditions, loops and calculations when a script runs but its output is wrong.

questions.text: Which one of the following can be considered as a runtime error?
options: Excluding a ; at the end of a PHP statement
Using = instead of  == in an expression
The database server the PHP script is trying to connect to is unavailable
Coding a while loop that iterates incorrect number of times
questions.correctAnswer: The database server the PHP script is trying to connect to is unavailable
questions.explanation:
An unavailable database server causes a failure when the PHP script tries to connect during execution.

Student note: An unavailable service is an execution issue, unlike a missing semicolon (syntax) or incorrect arithmetic (logic).

questions.text: Which of the following is not considered a common syntax error in PHP?
options: using a keyword as a variable name
questions.explanation:
Using the wrong variable in multiplication can produce a wrong result while remaining valid PHP syntax.

Student note: Even correctly written code can be wrong in its logic. Trace variables and values to find this kind of bug.
